name: Emiw
description: A star 36 parsecs away, the Sun's width, measured from its light.

radius.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 5529: radius 0.983 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 0.695 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.048) and temperature

temperature.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 5529: effective temperature 5318 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.039)

distance.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 5529: distance 36.156 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.008), at which the luminosity and radius hold

limb.none: no mass is measured and no spectroscopic surface gravity is published with this radius: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770 assume the gravity of their fit (table column 15)

text.card: A star 36 parsecs away, the Sun's width, measured from its light.
text.introduction: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 0.695 times the Sun's luminosity at 5,318 K, so 0.983 solar radii.
text.locator: Table 2, HIP 5529: D, Teff, L, Rad, Q

quotes.title: HD 7199
quotes.card: HD 7199 is a star in the constellation Tucana located 118 light years distance from the Sun based on parallax.
quotes.introduction: It has an orange hue but is too dim to be viewed with the naked eye, having an apparent visual magnitude of +8.06.
